requirement.description: The receive_messages method does not properly yield parsed messages from transport. The implementation should correctly iterate over transport's async iterator and yield parsed Message objects.
requirement.contract: Fix the receive_messages method to properly yield parsed messages: async for data in self._transport.receive_messages(): yield parse_message(data)

requirement.description: The __aexit__ method does not reliably call disconnect() for proper cleanup.
requirement.contract: Ensure __aexit__ method reliably calls disconnect() even when exceptions occur.

requirement.description: The receive_response method does not properly terminate iteration after yielding a ResultMessage.
requirement.contract: receive_response should yield messages and stop iteration when a ResultMessage is encountered.

requirement.description: The process_query method does not guarantee transport cleanup on exceptions.
requirement.contract: Use try/finally to ensure transport.disconnect() is always called.

requirement.description: The receive_messages method needs to properly handle async iteration semantics.
requirement.contract: receive_messages should properly yield parsed messages from CLI output stream.
